source_audit.rational_payload_result: No surviving exact_rational_witness alias consumer required a rational numerator/denominator. Every consumer accepted an arbitrary exact Real point. Genuine rational-root theorem and reconstruction code already gates with Real::exact_rational_ref and remains unchanged.

BezierParameter2::promote_represented_exact_point and BezierParameterRange2::promote_represented_exact_endpoints are the sole public promotions; both historical rational-named methods were deleted
the shared OnceLock keeps the identical Option<Real> payload and cache behavior under an exact-point name

mathematical_authority.exact_point: A stored exact point is any exact Real expression. It is not evidence of a rational normal form.
mathematical_authority.rational_payload: A caller that needs a rational payload must call Real::exact_rational_ref. Rational-root theorem denominator bounds, modular rejection, and reconstruction continue to do so explicitly.
mathematical_authority.linear_parameter: A validated linear isolator may materialize its exact scalar-tower quotient, including a non-rational Real such as 1/pi, after exact polynomial and interval replay.
mathematical_authority.nonlinear_parameter: The existing higher-degree path remains deliberately narrower: it reconstructs only rational roots of exact-rational coefficient polynomials and otherwise retains the algebraic carrier.
mathematical_authority.selected_field: Only already-materialized exact points become constants. A represented root without an exact point remains an authored tensor/recursive-field axis, preserving correlation.
mathematical_authority.policy: No policy branch, approximation permission, validation requirement, or uncertainty/error mapping changed.
mathematical_authority.coordinate_order: Point [x,y], vector [dx,dy], coefficient, split-boundary, and overlap-range order are unchanged.

regression_evidence.pre_fix: The new public non-rational linear-parameter regression failed to compile because represented_exact_point and promote_represented_exact_point did not exist; users had to call APIs whose names falsely implied a rational payload.
